senses.gloss: aḍḍhatiya (= Pali id., acc. to CPD by haplol. for aḍḍhatatiya = Skt. ardhatṛtīya), or aḍḍhā˚, two and a half. Senartʼs Index cites only aḍḍhātiya, which is read in text Mv 〔iii.72.12〕 (mss. āvṛttiya) and 13 (mss. aṭṭātiya or āṭṭā˚), while aḍḍhatiya is read in text Mv 〔ii.312.10〕 (mss. aṭṭāti, omitting ya) and 〔iii.75.7〕 (mss. aṭṭatiya).
